command: set -e; if [ -z "$CODELLDB_PATH" ]; then store=$(nix build --no-link --print-out-paths nixpkgs#vscode-extensions.vadimcn.vscode-lldb 2>/tmp/vimspector-codelldb-nix.log); CODELLDB_PATH="$store/share/vscode/extensions/vadimcn.vscode-lldb/adapter/codelldb"; fi; exec "$CODELLDB_PATH"

shell: cd apps/rust && cargo test --no-run --lib --message-format=json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; [print(m["executable"]) for line in sys.stdin if (m:=json.loads(line)).get("reason") == "compiler-artifact" and m.get("target", {}).get("kind") == ["lib"] and m.get("executable")]'
